hypothesis: Proportional risk sizing without dynamic stop synchronization may improve stock-only net CAGR; it is increased risk exposure, not new stock-selection alpha.
decision_rule: All primary costs and the older-boundary sensitivity must gain at least 1pp net CAGR with no more than 1pp drawdown worsening; primary 25bp paired CAGR interval lower bound must exceed zero and at least 3 calendar slices must improve. Passing is only a historical screen.
